name: kubernetes_agent
description: An agent that manages Kubernetes clusters, produces deployment-ready manifests from templates, creates namespaces, and bootstraps ArgoCD applications.

skills.name: Manifest Generation
skills.description: Fill in Kubernetes manifest templates (Deployment, Service, NetworkPolicy, Ingress, ArgoCD Application) from placeholders.

skills.name: Namespace Management
skills.description: Create target namespaces on the Kubernetes cluster.

skills.name: ArgoCD Bootstrap
skills.description: Apply ArgoCD Application manifests to the cluster and poll sync/health status.

skills.name: Resource Validation
skills.description: Map Small/Medium/Large resource tiers to exact CPU and Memory requests and limits.
